episodes.synopsis: On the hunt for some tasty Poké Beans, Scraggy runs into a peculiar Pokémon—Mimikyu! Mimikyu wants to be friends, but Scraggy only wants snacks. Watch as they chase each other toward a potential friendship.
episodes.title: Scraggy and Mimikyu

episodes.synopsis: Pancham dreams of becoming a hero, so it trains every day. When some people and Pokémon are in trouble, does Pancham have what it takes to be the hero they need?
episodes.title: The Pancham Who Wants to Be a Hero

episodes.synopsis: Blossom’s goal is to become a Pokémon League Champion! During a trip into the forest, she has a chance encounter with a Pokémon who will test her dreams.
episodes.title: Blossom’s Dream

episodes.synopsis: A loyal Magikarp wants nothing more than to make a friend.
episodes.title: Wait for Me, Magikarp!

episodes.synopsis: Spend a cozy, snowy day in a house full of friendly Pokémon.
episodes.title: The Slugma-Powered Home

episodes.synopsis: Afterschool activities get more interesting when a mysterious Gengar stirs up some fun.
episodes.title: Help! I've Turned into a Gengar

episodes.synopsis: A hot summer day suddenly turns into a snowy wonderland for three friends. Could a Pokémon have something to do with it?
episodes.title: Snorunt's Summer Vacation

episodes.synopsis: Jigglypuff is sad because its song isn’t like the songs of other Jigglypuff. Will it be able to find the right melody with a friend’s help?
episodes.title: Jigglypuff's Song
